  • Constructor Details

    • CriterionPolicy

      public CriterionPolicy(String id, String unit, Double lowerLimit, Double upperLimit, CompressorAutomationAcceptancePolicy.DeadlineBasis deadlineBasis, Double deadlineSeconds, DynamicScenarioCriterion.EvaluationMode evaluationMode, boolean required)
      Creates explicit settings for one stable compressor observation.
      Parameters:
      id - stable criterion identifier
      unit - exact observation unit
      lowerLimit - optional finite lower bound
      upperLimit - optional finite upper bound
      deadlineBasis - event-relative deadline basis
      deadlineSeconds - fixed seconds for CompressorAutomationAcceptancePolicy.DeadlineBasis.SECONDS_AFTER_EVENT, otherwise null
      evaluationMode - reach or maintained-bound evaluation
      required - whether failure contributes to the scenario verdict
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if identity, bounds, deadline or mode is invalid
